description: Maki's and Kilo CLI's Homebrew formulae and the Devin CLI and Warp Agent CLI casks, installed and not run.
why: Nothing else on this machine names any of these agents, so each Homebrew token is its only witness. windsurf is forbidden because its cask is devin-desktop, and the devin-cli token must not be read as it; opencode because Kilo's CLI forks it.
